name: Aldar Education – Al Shohub Private School (Teacher – Inclusion, AY 27/28)
note:
I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education specialist with an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools as an inclusive education coordinator and resource room teacher. I have also worked in Qatar as a special education specialist.
I managed resource rooms and built an IEP for every student, led teacher training in inclusive education, and achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a public school.
I am applying for the Teacher – Inclusion position at Al Shohub Private School. My CV is attached.
